heading: Islamic Misinformation Casebook
summary: Islamic Misinformation Casebook is a fixed collection of twelve evidence-reading exercises. Open a constructed claim, inspect the cited material and choose a conclusion that stays within the evidence. You can then copy a correction with its references. It practices source reading without claiming to verify every live post or measure which claims are currently viral.
steps: Choose a claim from the case catalog.
Read the evidence before selecting the conclusion it supports.
Inspect the explanation and copy the correction with its references if useful.

questions.question: Can I paste a social media post here for automatic fact-checking?
questions.answer: No. The app uses a fixed, cited case bank. It does not evaluate arbitrary visitor claims or perform a live fact-checking service.

questions.question: Does Beyond the cited evidence mean false in every context?
questions.answer: No. It keeps the conclusion narrower than a universal rejection. The exercise asks what this evidence supports, rather than claiming that every possible source or context has been examined.
